ghi_chu: Lô kể chuyện 26/10/2026 — anh duyệt 6 phim (~$8–10, trần $4/phim, $24 tổng). Khuôn = bản thắng #55604 Step Back (kc2510v, 34s): kể ngôi thứ nhất, 6 cảnh chữ ngắn, hook câu đầu, cú lật hiện NGAY trong hình ở cảnh 5, thẻ cuối viết thường theo luật AFS (không Tap/mũi tên/FREE in hoa). Truyện theo tóm tắt chính thức của app gốc (QC spy + trang phim), không bịa chi tiết trái phim. Hình: không vũ khí, không máu, không cảnh gợi dục, nhân vật luôn mặc kín; poster gốc hở hang → thẻ cuối tả riêng (the_cuoi_anh). ¡Atrás! (92980): phim #307 đã thành creative #55605 (kể bản ngân hàng quỳ) → bản này góc MỚI: subjefe hôn nhẫn + đề nghị 1.000 triệu.

phim.ten: ¡Atrás! No te metas con ese vagabundo
phim.nhan_vat: VINCE = rugged man late 30s, long messy brown hair, full beard, worn dark coat (narrator, poster hero holding a gold signet ring); HELEN = elegant blonde CEO in a white dress; PHILIP WEST = smug young man in a navy suit; HELEN'S MOTHER = woman 50s, dark bob, navy dress, pearls; UNDERBOSS = broad grey-haired man 60s in a black suit and black tie

boi_canh.mo_ta: Sunlit Mediterranean-style mansion with a fountain garden and a grand marble hall with a crystal chandelier; rainy night city street outside

canh.loi: Llegué a la mansión de su familia vestido de vagabundo. A propósito.
canh.anh: Grand front steps of a sunlit mansion. VINCE in his worn dark coat and full beard stands calmly at the door; HELEN in a white dress holds his arm proudly.
canh.dong: VINCE looks up at the mansion with a calm half-smile, HELEN squeezes his arm, slow push-in on his face.

canh.loi: Helen, la CEO que salvé hace dos años, me pidió matrimonio en la calle.
canh.anh: Busy city sidewalk at dusk. HELEN in a white dress holds VINCE's rough hands, passersby stop and stare.
canh.dong: HELEN takes his hands and smiles, VINCE looks at her surprised, handheld camera circles them.

canh.loi: Su madre me miró como si fuera basura.
canh.anh: Mansion garden by a fountain. HELEN'S MOTHER in a navy dress and pearls looks VINCE up and down with disgust, arms crossed.
canh.dong: The mother wrinkles her nose and turns her face away from VINCE, slow sideways track.

canh.loi: Y la obligaban a casarse con Philip West.
canh.anh: Same garden. PHILIP WEST in a navy suit smirks and pulls HELEN to his side while her mother nods approvingly; VINCE stands alone in his worn coat.
canh.dong: PHILIP pulls HELEN closer and smirks at VINCE, HELEN looks back at VINCE, wide pan across the group.

canh.loi: Entonces entró un subjefe y besó mi anillo.
canh.anh: Grand marble hall with a crystal chandelier. The grey-haired UNDERBOSS in a black suit bows low and kisses the gold signet ring on VINCE's hand; HELEN'S MOTHER and PHILIP stare frozen.
canh.dong: The underboss bends and kisses the ring, the mother's jaw drops, camera pushes in on the ring.

canh.loi: Pero Helen ya me había elegido cuando yo no tenía nada.
canh.anh: Same hall. HELEN in her white dress takes VINCE's hand and stands beside him; her mother and PHILIP lower their heads in the background.
canh.dong: HELEN laces her fingers with his and smiles, VINCE looks at her, camera cranes up over the hall.

phim.nhan_vat: ELIJAH = handsome dark-haired man mid-30s, strong jaw, light stubble, ALWAYS FULLY CLOTHED in a fitted charcoal suit or a dark buttoned shirt (narrator; face as on the poster, never shirtless); CHRISTINE = elegant blonde woman early 30s, hair in an updo, cream business suit, cold expression; GRANDFATHER = silver-haired billionaire in his 80s, grey suit

boi_canh.mo_ta: Modern glass penthouse at night with a city skyline view and a dark marble dining table; sleek CEO office with floor-to-ceiling windows; an ornate golden oil lamp on a shelf

canh.loi: Fui un genio atrapado en una lámpara durante miles de años.
canh.anh: Dark antique room. An ornate golden oil lamp on a velvet cloth glows; golden mist rises and forms ELIJAH in a charcoal suit, his calm eyes glowing faintly gold.
canh.dong: Golden mist swirls up from the lamp and ELIJAH steps out of it, slow push-in on his eyes.

canh.loi: Mi libertad tenía un precio: casarme con su nieta, Christine.
canh.anh: Elegant study. The silver-haired GRANDFATHER places CHRISTINE's hand into ELIJAH's hand; CHRISTINE in a cream suit looks away coldly.
canh.dong: The grandfather joins their hands, CHRISTINE pulls her hand back slightly, handheld camera drifts around them.

canh.loi: En secreto, la convertí en una gran directora ejecutiva.
canh.anh: Sleek CEO office. CHRISTINE signs a big contract at her desk while ELIJAH stands unseen by the window, a faint golden glow at his fingertips.
canh.dong: ELIJAH flicks his fingers and a soft golden spark drifts to the contract, CHRISTINE smiles at her success, slow sideways track.

canh.loi: Pero ella me ignoró y me despreció cada día.
canh.anh: Penthouse dining table at night. ELIJAH sets down a carefully cooked dinner; CHRISTINE in her suit walks past without looking, phone to her ear.
canh.dong: CHRISTINE brushes past the table, ELIJAH lowers his eyes, wide pan across the empty table.

canh.loi: Al final de los cinco años, firmé el divorcio. Y ella vio la luz.
canh.anh: Same penthouse. ELIJAH signs divorce papers on the table; golden light pours from his hand and the golden lamp on the shelf blazes; CHRISTINE freezes in the doorway, stunned.
canh.dong: ELIJAH signs and golden light flares around him, CHRISTINE's eyes widen, camera pushes in on her face.

canh.loi: Ahora sabe a quién le debía todo su éxito.
canh.anh: CEO office at night. CHRISTINE alone at her desk holds the golden lamp with both hands, looking at it in realization; the city lights behind her.
canh.dong: CHRISTINE turns the lamp in her hands and looks up toward the door, camera cranes up and away.

phim.the_cuoi_anh: Movie key art of the two leads from the reference poster, fully clothed: ELIJAH in a fitted charcoal suit with arms crossed in front, CHRISTINE in an elegant cream evening gown with a modest high neckline beside him, a glowing golden lamp and a night city skyline behind them, dramatic warm backlight, empty dark space in the lower third for title text, vertical 9:16.

phim.nhan_vat: SOPHIA = young woman early 20s, long brown hair in a low bun, black nanny dress with a white collar (narrator, poster center); VICTOR = tall stern man mid-30s, slicked-back black hair, black three-piece suit; THE BABIES = four toddlers from the poster (two little boys in tiny black suits, a baby boy in a blue romper, a red-haired baby girl in a lace dress); BUTLER = thin man 40s in a grey suit with a sly look

boi_canh.mo_ta: Baroque golden mansion with marble staircase and a sunny pastel nursery full of toys; dark wood study for the boss

canh.loi: After a crash, I woke up in a stranger's life. Buried in debt.
canh.anh: Plain small bedroom at dawn. SOPHIA sits up in bed in shock, holding a stack of overdue bills, staring at her own reflection in a mirror.
canh.dong: SOPHIA drops the bills and touches her face in the mirror, slow push-in on her eyes.

canh.loi: To pay it, I became nanny to Victor, the most feared godfather in town.
canh.anh: Dark wood study. VICTOR in a black three-piece suit sits behind a big desk and studies SOPHIA coldly; she stands in her nanny dress holding a contract.
canh.dong: VICTOR slides the contract toward her without a smile, SOPHIA swallows and signs, handheld camera.

canh.loi: His four wild little heirs drove every nanny away.
canh.anh: Sunny pastel nursery in chaos. The four toddlers throw toys and pillows; SOPHIA stands in the doorway, hair messy, a toy stuck on her shoulder.
canh.dong: A pillow flies past SOPHIA, the toddlers giggle, slow sideways track across the mess.

canh.loi: Victor gave me one rule. One mistake, and I'm out.
canh.anh: Marble staircase. VICTOR looks down at SOPHIA from the top step and raises one finger; the sly BUTLER watches from behind him.
canh.dong: VICTOR lifts one finger and turns away, the butler smirks, wide pan up the staircase.

canh.loi: Then I heard the babies' thoughts. They warned me about the butler.
canh.anh: Nursery. SOPHIA kneels and hugs the four toddlers close while staring at the sly BUTLER, who freezes in the doorway holding a baby bottle; VICTOR appears behind him.
canh.dong: SOPHIA pulls the babies behind her and points at the butler, VICTOR grabs the bottle from his hand, camera pushes in on SOPHIA.

canh.loi: Now the godfather who trusts no one is breaking every rule for me.
canh.anh: Golden hall at sunset. VICTOR in his black suit holds one of the toddlers and offers SOPHIA his hand with a rare soft smile; the other babies cling to her dress.
canh.dong: VICTOR reaches for her hand and smiles, SOPHIA hesitates then takes it, camera cranes up over them.

phim.nhan_vat: LUCAS = rugged man mid-30s, short dark hair, stubble, worn brown leather jacket over a grey T-shirt (narrator, the man on the poster); CARLOTA = young woman late 20s, long dark wavy hair, FULLY CLOTHED in a denim jacket over a high-neck white top and jeans; UNCLE = man in his 50s, grey goatee, cream linen suit, sunglasses; SISTER = young woman asleep in a hospital bed with monitors

boi_canh.mo_ta: Endless sun-baked Mojave desert highway with Joshua trees and red rocks; a dusty old pickup truck; a quiet hospital room

canh.loi: Por mi hermana en coma, acepté un trabajo peligroso.
canh.anh: Quiet hospital room. LUCAS in his leather jacket holds the hand of his SISTER asleep in a hospital bed with soft monitor light.
canh.dong: LUCAS squeezes her hand, stands up and puts on his jacket with resolve, slow push-in on his face.

canh.loi: Escoltar a una chica, Carlota, a través del desierto de Mojave.
canh.anh: Desert highway at noon. CARLOTA in a denim jacket climbs into the passenger seat of LUCAS's dusty pickup truck, clutching a small leather folder.
canh.dong: CARLOTA hugs the folder and slams the door, LUCAS starts the engine, handheld camera at the window.

canh.loi: No me dijo que llevaba pruebas para salvar a su abuelo.
canh.anh: Inside the truck cab. CARLOTA opens the leather folder showing photos and papers; LUCAS glances at it sharply while driving.
canh.dong: LUCAS looks from the road to the papers and back, CARLOTA closes the folder nervously, slow sideways track.

canh.loi: Gente muy peligrosa nos siguió por todo el desierto.
canh.anh: Wide desert highway. The dusty pickup races ahead while three black SUVs follow far behind in a long trail of dust.
canh.dong: The pickup speeds along the road, the SUVs close the distance, wide aerial pan.

canh.loi: Y el que nos traicionó fue su propio tío.
canh.anh: Desert roadside at sunset. The UNCLE in a cream linen suit steps out of a black SUV and takes off his sunglasses with a cold smile; CARLOTA stares at him in shock, LUCAS shields her.
canh.dong: The uncle removes his sunglasses and smiles, CARLOTA steps back, camera pushes in on her shocked face.

canh.loi: Cruzamos el infierno juntos. Y decidimos no separarnos nunca.
canh.anh: Desert at sunrise beside the dusty pickup. LUCAS and CARLOTA stand side by side holding hands, looking at the horizon, golden light on their faces.
canh.dong: CARLOTA rests her head on his shoulder, LUCAS smiles, camera cranes up into the sunrise.

phim.the_cuoi_anh: Movie key art of the two leads from the reference poster, fully clothed and not kissing: LUCAS in a worn brown leather jacket and CARLOTA in a denim jacket over a high-neck white top stand back to back beside a dusty pickup truck on a Mojave desert highway at sunset, dramatic warm backlight, empty dark space in the lower third for title text, vertical 9:16.

phim.ten: Called Me a Gold Digger? So Why Is He Begging?
phim.nhan_vat: FREDA = young woman late 20s, long auburn hair, elegant ivory dress with a modest high neckline (narrator, poster center); VICTOR = handsome dark-haired billionaire early 30s, black tuxedo; VICTOR'S MOTHER = blonde woman 50s in a burgundy gown, pearls

boi_canh.mo_ta: Luxurious chandelier ballroom and long candlelit dining table in a billionaire mansion; bright modern airport terminal

canh.loi: For three years, they called me a gold digger.
canh.anh: Chandelier ballroom. Elegant guests whisper and point at FREDA in an ivory dress; VICTOR'S MOTHER in a burgundy gown sneers at her.
canh.dong: The guests whisper behind their hands, FREDA keeps her chin up, slow push-in on her face.

canh.loi: My billionaire fiancé, Victor, never once defended me.
canh.anh: Same ballroom. VICTOR in a black tuxedo stands silent beside his mother, avoiding FREDA's eyes, a glass in his hand.
canh.dong: FREDA looks to VICTOR for help, he looks away and sips, handheld camera.

canh.loi: Then he asked me again: do you love me, or my money?
canh.anh: Candlelit dining table. VICTOR leans toward FREDA with a doubtful frown; his mother watches with a satisfied smile.
canh.dong: VICTOR asks with a cold frown, FREDA's eyes fill with tears, slow sideways track.

canh.loi: So I gave back the ring and left for a job overseas.
canh.anh: Same dining room. FREDA places her engagement ring on the white tablecloth in front of VICTOR, stands and walks out; VICTOR stares at the ring.
canh.dong: FREDA sets down the ring and walks away without looking back, wide pan following her out.

canh.loi: Only after I left did Victor learn the truth.
canh.anh: Empty dim mansion study at night. VICTOR alone reads a thick file of papers, his face pale with shock, FREDA's ring on the desk beside him.
canh.dong: VICTOR flips a page and freezes, drops the file, camera pushes in on his stunned face.

canh.loi: Now the billionaire is begging. But I've moved on.
canh.anh: Bright airport arrivals hall. VICTOR holds a big bouquet and pleads with FREDA, who walks past him confidently in a smart beige coat, rolling her suitcase.
canh.dong: VICTOR steps toward her with the flowers, FREDA keeps walking with a calm smile, camera cranes up over the hall.

phim.the_cuoi_anh: Movie key art from the reference poster: FREDA with long auburn hair in an elegant ivory gown with a modest high neckline stands proudly in a chandelier ballroom, VICTOR in a black tuxedo behind her holding out an open ring box, dramatic warm backlight, empty dark space in the lower third for title text, vertical 9:16.

phim.ten: The Discarded Wife Is the Queen of Luxury
phim.nhan_vat: FREYA = elegant woman about 30, light brown hair in a sleek bun, pearl drop earrings, grey eyes (narrator, poster center); HUSBAND = handsome man early 30s, short brown hair, navy suit; MOTHER-IN-LAW = woman 60s, grey bob, beige skirt suit; ASSISTANTS = young staff in black suits

boi_canh.ten: Husband's family home and Alysia headquarters
boi_canh.mo_ta: Cold upscale family living room with grey sofas; gleaming white-and-gold luxury brand headquarters lobby with the brand name ALYSIA on the wall

canh.loi: For years, I hid who I really was. For him.
canh.anh: Plain kitchen in an upscale home. FREYA in a simple apron over a grey sweater quietly sets dishes on the counter, pearl earrings catching the light.
canh.dong: FREYA pauses and looks at her reflection in a window, slow push-in on her calm eyes.

canh.loi: I gave up everything to be his wife.
canh.anh: Family living room. FREYA serves tea to her HUSBAND in a navy suit; he scrolls his phone and does not look at her.
canh.dong: FREYA sets down the cup, the husband waves her away without looking, handheld camera.

canh.loi: His family called me a useless housewife.
canh.anh: Same living room. The MOTHER-IN-LAW in a beige suit points at FREYA's apron and laughs with the husband.
canh.dong: The mother-in-law laughs and points, FREYA lowers her eyes, slow sideways track.

canh.loi: Then he betrayed me to pay off his debts.
canh.anh: Same room at night. The HUSBAND pushes a signed paper across the table toward FREYA and turns his back on her; her suitcase stands by the door.
canh.dong: The husband slides the paper over and walks away, FREYA picks it up stunned, wide pan.

canh.loi: So I took off the apron. I'm the founder of Alysia.
canh.anh: Gleaming white-and-gold luxury headquarters lobby with ALYSIA on the wall. FREYA in a sharp white suit walks in; a row of ASSISTANTS in black bow to her.
canh.dong: FREYA strides through the lobby and the staff bow as she passes, camera pushes in on her face.

canh.loi: Now the family that threw me away can only watch.
canh.anh: Glamorous launch event stage with gold lights. FREYA in the white suit is applauded on stage; the HUSBAND and MOTHER-IN-LAW stand at the back of the crowd, stunned.
canh.dong: The crowd applauds FREYA, the husband's smile falls, camera cranes up over the hall.

phim.the_cuoi_anh: Movie key art from the reference poster: FREYA with light brown hair in a sleek bun and pearl earrings in an elegant ivory gown with a modest neckline, holding a torn wedding photo of her husband, glittering gold chandelier light behind her, dramatic backlight, empty dark space in the lower third for title text, vertical 9:16.
